title: Kernel criterion for the presheaf Cech Ext edge map
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-presheaf-cech-ext-edge-injective, every class in the kernel of the Cech Ext edge map is zero.

proof.text: Obtain the exact syzygy ladder of [lem-sc-presheaf-cech-sheaf-resolution] and the additive cochain comparison of [lem-sc-presheaf-cech-sheaf-hom-comparison]. Keep the original augmentation under its degree-zero isomorphism.

For n+1=q, a map g:K_n -> F produces a cocycle p_n followed by g. Exactness in degree q follows from the given zero Čech homology using HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology. ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff makes the cocycle a boundary; the additive comparison transports its primitive to t:A_n -> F. Cancel the epimorphism p_n to obtain i_n followed by t equal to g.

Induct on b>0 with n+b+1=q to prove Ext^b(K_n,F)=0. Lower Ext vanishing on A_(n+1) lets Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ lift any class through the next short exact sequence. For b=1 its lift is a morphism K_(n+1)->F; the preceding extension argument and ShortExact.extClass_comp_assoc kill its connecting class. For b>1 the induction hypothesis kills the lift. This is the proved private helper syzygy_ext_vanish.

Transport the original edge-kernel equation across e0 using Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc. The initial short exact sequence lifts x to Ext^(q-1)(K0,F) by Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃. For q=1 extend the corresponding morphism to A0 and use extClass_comp_assoc. For q>1 apply syzygy_ext_vanish at n=0. In both cases the connecting image x is zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 079Z edge-kernel consequence, using the augmented nerve of Tag 01GC; direct Yoneda Ext syzygy proof formalized by K2.

lean.statement:
theorem presheafCech_ext_edge_kernel
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    [HasExt.{w'} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (f : Arrow (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v))
    (hf : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f.hom) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlower : ∀ (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v) (b : ℕ), 0 < b → b < q →
      Subsingleton
        (Ext ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).obj (P ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)) F b))
    (hcech : IsZero ((presheafCechComplex f F.obj).homology q)) :
    ∀ (x : Ext ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).obj (f.right ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)) F q),
      (Ext.mk₀ ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map
      (Functor.whiskerRight f.hom AddCommGrpCat.free))).comp x (Nat.zero_add q) = 0 → x = 0
